prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "simning". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "swimming".
Scene: Adult swimmer doing relaxed lengths in clear pool, lane ropes and coach at side, no performance or health outcome claims beyond supplied example.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "simning = swimming; the activity of moving through water.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Simning är bra motion.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
